paper_title: CodeRAG-Bench Can Retrieval Augment Code Generation
caption: Performance with different chunking sizes.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of different sources with varying chunking sizes, measured by an unspecified metric. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, with a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, marked at intervals of 200. The y-axis also has a linear scale, with values from 10 to 40, marked at intervals of 10. The plot contains four lines: blue for Tutorials, red for Library Documentation, yellow for StackOverflow posts, and green for Github files. The blue line starts at approximately 20 and increases to around 30. The red line starts at around 25 and increases to approximately 32, then decreases to about 28. The yellow line starts at around 32 and decreases to approximately 12. The green line starts at around 28 and increases to approximately 32, then decreases slightly to around 30.
